desc:
☕ Welcome to Frappé Café V4! "Unforgettable Joy!"
https://www.roblox.com/groups/950346/Frapp#!/about

✨ Roleplay as a customer and order from our delicious menu or become a Barista and craft drinks to work your way up!

📋 Wondering how to start your career with us and become a Trainee? Join the group and visit our Application Center by using the "/apply" command in-game!

🧑‍🍳 Need to rank up to Junior Barista after passing the application? Join the Training Center by using the "/train" command in-game!

👍 Enjoying our café? Make sure to give us a thumbs-up and a favorite to support us! We may host events and giveaways at milestones!
